create_stopwatch_timer: create a Stopwatch instance to measure elapsed execution time with optional CUDA device synchronization
start_stopwatch: start the Stopwatch to begin measuring elapsed time using perf_counter
stop_stopwatch: stop the Stopwatch and accumulate the measured duration into the total elapsed time
get_elapsed_time_stopwatch: get the current elapsed time from the Stopwatch including any accumulated duration
use_stopwatch_context_manager: use the Stopwatch as a context manager to automatically start and stop timing a code block
